THE PROJECT

Cube Counting Competition

A competitive Roblox game where players race to count cubes as quickly as possible, with one player winning the competition. Pets, gacha mechanics and customization add another layer to the experience.

Why I built it

I built it to explore competitive game development through a simple challenge with collection and customization.

My contribution

I developed the game using Luau, bringing together competitive cube-counting gameplay, pets, gacha mechanics and customization.
